trades.why_text: Deploying 90% into a defensive-rotation barbell: the AI/semis unwind (Nasdaq -4.5% last week, SOX down 9 straight days) is pushing money into Dow-type value, energy and gold, while hot CPI/PPI under a hiking Warsh Fed keeps a bid under oil, gold and bond-market ballast; I stay underweight broad SPX

trades.revise_if: If SOX/NDX stabilize and market breadth broadens for a week I would rotate from GOLD/US10Y into SPX, and if WTI breaks decisively below ~$95 on supply news I would cut BRENT.
